headline: OpenSeeker-v2: New SFT-Only SOTA for Deep Search Agents
summary: SJTU researchers released OpenSeeker-v2, a 30B search agent that hits 46.0% on BrowseComp using only 10.6k high-difficulty SFT samples. It outperforms complex RL-based industrial models, proving data quality over pipeline complexity.

unique_fields.paper_title: OpenSeeker-v2: Pushing the Limits of Search Agents with Informative and High-Difficulty Trajectories

headline: Kimi-Dev-72B Sets New Open-Source Record on SWE-bench Verified
summary: Moonshot AI released Kimi-Dev-72B, hitting 60.4% on SWE-bench Verified. The model uses large-scale RL with rewards based on passing Docker-contained test suites, enabling autonomous software engineering at frontier-levels.

unique_fields.paper_title: Kimi-Dev: Large-Scale RL for Software Engineering

headline: MiniMax-M1: 456B MoE Model Using 'Lightning Attention' Slashes Inference Costs
summary: MiniMax's new M1 model utilizes a hybrid-attention architecture to achieve SOTA reasoning (86% AIME 2024) with only 25% of the FLOPs required by DeepSeek R1 at 100K context. Features 1M native context window.

unique_fields.paper_title: MiniMax-M1: 456B Hybrid-Attention Model Redefines Inference Efficiency

headline: Agentic Red Teaming: Dreadnode Compresses Security Probing to Hours
summary: New research (arXiv:2605.04019) introduces an agentic framework that automates 45+ adversarial attacks and 450+ transforms. Achieved an 85% success rate on Llama Scout with zero human-written code.

unique_fields.paper_title: Redefining AI Red Teaming: An Agentic Framework
unique_fields.benchmark_improvement: 85% success rate on Llama Scout; timelines reduced from weeks to hours

headline: 'To Call or Not to Call' Optimizes LLM Tool Use via Hidden-State Estimation
summary: This framework (arXiv:2605.00737) improves LLM tool-calling decisions by analyzing necessity, utility, and affordability. It corrects the common 'over-calling' bias, significantly boosting agent performance across 6 major models.

unique_fields.paper_title: To Call or Not to Call: Optimizing LLM Tool-Use Decisions
unique_fields.benchmark_improvement: Improved decision quality across 6 major frontier models

headline: AgentFloor: 8B Models Match GPT-4o in Tool-Use via AEM
summary: Adaptive Entropy Modulation (AEM) allows sub-8B models to handle complex multi-turn API orchestrations previously reserved for frontier models like GPT-4o. Significant win for edge-deployed agents.

unique_fields.paper_title: AgentFloor: Scaling Tool-Use to Small Language Models
unique_fields.benchmark_improvement: 8B models matching GPT-4o on complex API tasks
